gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-chivo: Metamorphous spaces its letters generously and sets its midline high, with only a gentle fat-to-slim shift in the strokes. Chivo is a plain sans with lowercase packed up toward the caps, and every curve lets daylight through.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-chocolate-classic: Commanding up top, Metamorphous moves at a reading pace smoothed by mild stroke differences. Chocolate Classical Sans answers with a sizable lowercase and a broad-nibbed pen stroke that never curls shut, a sturdy, open counterpart.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-comme: Distinctive, that's Metamorphous, with its high midline and soft stroke shifts. Comme is a plain sans with lowercase bodies filling most of the letter height, so bump its size up a notch and the smooth, unclogged curves open further.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-cossette-texte: Wide-set and a bit regal. Metamorphous carries a light swell in each bowl like pressed glass, while Cossette Texte looks bent from a single wire, with a prominent x-height and wide-eyed lowercase e.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-duru-sans: Duru Sans reads wide and open, its small letters dominating the line while ascenders barely show. Metamorphous differs by letting its bowls swell gently where they curve, a soft shift the plain sans never makes.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-fresca: Stately spacing, high midline, soft strokes. Metamorphous swells modestly in its round letters, while Fresca drops the calligraphic thinning entirely, keeping diagonals matched to stems and counters connected to the outside space.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-funnel-sans: Funnel Sans keeps tiny gaps between ascender tops and the x-height line, and its lowercase e opens like a pried clasp. Metamorphous is the one with swell.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-gafata: Metamorphous has large sidebearings and a high midline, with strokes that ebb and flow in thickness. Gafata is the practical one, a tall band of lowercase under short stalks, each e looking wide-eyed.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-geist: Geist keeps a quiet, level beat with no accents of weight, and its openings spring wide like a paper clip. Words settle into solid blocks rather than skylines.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-georama: Large sidebearings and a high midline give Metamorphous its distinct stance. Georama lets a bracelet-wide c and barely rising capitals sit low beneath it, a relaxed foil to the heading.
